questions.q: If an attacker took one privileged account today, what could they reach?
questions.why: Puts a price on privilege before any tool is discussed.

questions.q: How long does it take to remove every access of someone who leaves?
questions.why: Offboarding time is the identity metric executives understand.

questions.q: How many directories and identity providers do you run, including the ones from acquisitions?
questions.why: Unconnected directories are where old accounts survive.

questions.q: Do you know every account with administrative rights, human and machine?
Is strong multi-factor required for every privileged sign-in, with no exceptions list?
When were access rights last reviewed, and who signed the review?
questions.why: Unsigned reviews are paperwork, not control.

questions.q: How many service accounts have passwords that never change?
questions.why: Static secrets are the quiet risk.

questions.q: When a risky sign-in alert fires, who acts and how fast?
questions.why: Detection without an owner is noise.
